scripts.build: bun run build:dashboard && bun run build:bot
scripts.db:setup: bun run db:generate && bun run db:push
scripts.dev:all: bun run dev:bot && bun run dev:dashboard
scripts.deploy: bun db:migrate:deploy && bun run quality:bot && bun deploy-commands
scripts.update:all: ncu -u && bun install && bun run quality:bot && bun deploy-commands
scripts.update:dashboard: ncu -u -f '^(?!@kotbo/.*)' && bun install && bun run quality:bot && bun deploy-commands
scripts.update:bot: ncu -u -f '^(?!@kotbo/.*)' && bun install && bun run quality:bot && bun deploy-commands
scripts.lint: bun run --filter @kotbo/bot lint && bun run --filter @kotbo/dashboard lint
scripts.format: bun run --filter @kotbo/bot format && bun run --filter @kotbo/dashboard format
